stories.title: Cook Medical visit
stories.summary: Cook Medical recently visited the Stephenson Cardiac Imaging Centre to explore potential opportunities for collaboration in the field of interventional MRI.

stories.title: Saying goodbye to Dr. Matthew Stewart
stories.summary: Matt finished his cardiovascular imaging fellowship. We would like to thank him again for all the experiences and his expertise he brought to the Centre!

stories.title: Saying goodbye to Dr. Zainab Althaha
stories.summary: We are pleased to congratulate Zainab on the successful completion of her cardiovascular imaging fellowship. Thank you, Zainab, for your contributions, and we wish you every success in your future endeavours

stories.title: SCIC and EP collaboration
stories.summary: The kick-off of a new and closer collaboration between the Stephenson Cardiac Imaging Centre and the electrophysiology team at Foothills Medical Centre.

stories.title: Preparation iCMR suite
stories.summary: With the arrival of the first instrumentation, SCIC is preparing for the launch of its first interventional procedures within the MRI environment.
